verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches natural-language interaction. The pricing page lists unspecified "Generative AI features", and Analytics AI explains campaign and revenue performance in plain language. Neither shows users issuing natural-language commands to operate the product. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language command or assistant interface for performing actions (creating campaigns, segmenting audiences, sending), detail on what the generative AI features accept as input, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
